column1: # Rows db.evnan.rps.* (line RG, X-evalue-nan, 2026-11-28): rpsblast `-evalue -nan` and `+inf`: the preliminary and traceback reaps drop an HSP only when its e-value is greater than -evalue (blast_engine.c:643-670, blast_hits.c:1976-2003; NaN keeps every HSP) and the composition-based redo's test of the best e-value (blast_kappa.c:3687) is false for NaN: RPS-BLAST's traceback gives the redo no sequence source, so the redo hands every list back without dividing the scores by the scaling factor, without bit scores and without counting identities (blast_kappa.c:3687-3733; the Seq-align's num_ident is 0). An infinite -evalue and DBL_MAX run with the redo too (the traceback drops an empty list before the hit list, blast_traceback.c:1272-1275; refused before). q40.faa and xoj.faa against rps_mini.

column12: X-evalue-nan: the composition-based redo (mode 1) hands every list back as it made it (RPS-BLAST's traceback gives it no sequence source): scaled scores, bit scores 0 (LOSAT kept none)

X-evalue-nan: an infinite -evalue without the redo (refused before)
